title: ScreenShot: A Foundation Model for Few-Shot Combination Drug Screening
abstract: arXiv:2608.12219v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Treating patients with combinations of drugs reduces the risk of resistance to any individual drug. Finding effective combinations is difficult because the large search space makes combinatorial screens prohibitively expensive, time consuming, and often technically infeasible. Predictive models can fill this gap, yet existing methods typically require molecular profiling of each sample and per-cohort training, limiting their applicability when time and tissue are scarce. To address this challenge, we introduce ScreenShot, a hierarchical transformer pretrained on 40 drug screening datasets covering 3,700 drugs and 6,000 biological samples, whose architecture mirrors the nested structure of screening data. translated_title: ScreenShot：一个用于少样本联合用药筛选的基础模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12219v1 公告类型：新 摘要：使用药物组合治疗患者可降低对任何单一药物产生耐药性的风险。由于搜索空间庞大，组合筛选成本高昂、耗时且通常在技术上不可行，因此找到有效组合十分困难。预测模型可以弥补这一空白，但现有方法通常需要对每个样本进行分子谱分析，并针对每个队列进行训练，这限制了它们在时间和组织样本稀缺时的适用性。为解决这一挑战，我们引入了ScreenShot，这是一个层级变换器模型，在涵盖3，700种药物和6，000个生物样本的40个药物筛选数据集上进行了预训练，其架构镜像了筛选数据的嵌套结构。给定来自新患者的少量观测上下文，ScreenShot通过上下文学习预测样本对联合治疗的反应，直接基于功能测量进行操作，无需微调且无需分子谱分析。
tldr: ScreenShot通过层级变换器架构和跨多个数据集的大规模预训练，实现了无需微调和分子谱分析的少样本联合用药疗效预测，显著提升了在稀缺资源条件下的适用性。
en_tdlr: ScreenShot enables few-shot combination drug response prediction without fine-tuning or molecular profiling by leveraging a hierarchical transformer pretrained on large-scale screening datasets, greatly enhancing applicability under resource-scarce conditions.
